mapper.select: SELECT FROM repository_catalog ORDER BY application,repository_name LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM repository_catalog WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM repository_catalog WHERE deleted=FALSE AND encrypted_secret IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(encrypted_secret)<>'' AND (auth_type IS NULL OR UPPER(auth_type)='SSH_KEY') ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM repository_catalog WHERE deleted=FALSE AND enabled=TRUE AND (application=#{application} OR application='ALL') ORDER BY application,repository_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repository_catalog WHERE deleted=FALSE AND LOWER(repository_name)=LOWER(#{name}) AND id<>#{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE repository_catalog SET repository_name=#{repositoryName},repository_url=#{repositoryUrl},application=#{application},version_no=#{versionNo},auth_type=#{authType},git_username=#{gitUsername},encrypted_secret=#{encryptedSecret},enabled=#{enabled},operator_user_id=#{operatorUserId},operator_user_name=#{operatorUserName},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE repository_catalog SET enabled=#{enabled},operator_user_id=1,operator_user_name='admin',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE repository_catalog SET deleted=TRUE,enabled=FALSE,operator_user_id=1,operator_user_name='admin',update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_repository_relation WHERE repository_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_repository_relation(user_id,repository_id,create_user_id,create_user_name) SELECT id,#{repositoryId},#{createUserId},#{createUserName} FROM system_user WHERE deleted=FALSE AND (application=#{application} OR application='ALL' OR #{application}='ALL')
